description: This file defines the UpgradeSavedSearch class, which contains logic to upgrade or migrate saved search configurations in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It performs database queries, data serialization/deserialization, and file existence checks to update saved searches, particularly focusing on 'team_name' fields and search form structures.

classes.name: UpgradeSavedSearch
classes.description: A class responsible for upgrading saved search configurations in the database, handling data transformations related to search form structure and legacy field compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that performs the migration/update process by iterating over saved searches and modifying their content.
